name: Projects
tip: Pick an existing wapp to edit or start a new one. Selecting a wapp loads its title, id, description, and home.ui.json into the editor tabs.

children.name: Projects
children.tip: Every wapp installed under ~/.local/share/geogram/apps/. Built-in wapps (tester, tasks, …) are not editable here yet.

name: Code
tip: Write a geogram wapp in C. Hit Compile to build it against the bundled wasm-clang, then Install to add it to the launcher.

children.name: source
children.label: source.c
children.tip: Plain C against the geogram HAL (wapps/hal/geogram_wasm_hal.h). No libc.

children.name: compile
children.label: Compile
children.tip: Run the bundled wasm-clang over the source above. Output goes to the log view below.

children.name: install
children.label: Install
children.tip: Write the compiled wapp into the launcher's installed-apps folder. If no fresh compile is available this reuses the existing app.wasm (edit metadata / UI only).

children.name: output
children.label: Compiler output
children.tip: Compiler stdout and stderr, plus host-side progress messages.

name: UI
tip: Raw home.ui.json for the wapp. Selecting a project on the Projects tab populates this; Install writes it back. A visual drag-and-drop editor will layer on top of this later.

children.name: source_ui
children.label: home.ui.json
children.tip: GeoUI screen definition. Leave empty for a default label screen. See wapps/wapps.md for the full schema.

name: Settings
tip: Metadata for the wapp you're editing. Title is what shows on the launcher grid; Name is the folder slug used on disk.

children.name: Identity
children.tip: These values end up in the generated manifest.json when you click Install.

children.name: wapp_title
children.label: Title
children.tip: Human-readable display name. This is what the launcher grid shows.

children.name: wapp_name
children.label: Name (folder slug)
children.tip: Short slug used as the folder name under ~/.local/share/geogram/apps/ and ~/.local/share/geogram/wapps/. Lowercase, no spaces.

children.name: wapp_id
children.label: ID (reverse domain)
children.tip: Stable identifier, goes into manifest.id. Convention: reverse-domain.

children.name: wapp_description
children.label: Description
children.default: A wapp I wrote inside geogram.

children.name: wapp_icon
children.label: Icon
children.tip: Type an emoji / single character, or click Choose SVG… to pick a vector icon file. Leave blank for the default Material icon.
